messages:
Maya (Product): quick q — SOC2 evidence retrieval SLA for audit streams from the FinServ pilot. Customers want guarantees around retention tiers, sample rates, and BYOK handshake delays. Can we map feasibility?
Ravi (Eng-Infra): short answer: yes for searchable evidence. Full raw exports are harder. Hot indexed 13mo -> we can do sub-24h for search slices; raw TAR exports depend on size. BYOK handshake currently has a ~30–90m tail during onboarding.
Lena (Security): note: exports must include integrity proofs (hashes) and a signed chain-of-custody. BYOK also requires key custody metadata; if escrow flow used that adds steps.
Omar (SRE): reality check: our export pipeline can assemble indexed slices in ~2–6h. Producing a raw full-data export of 500GB+ can take multiple days unless we prioritize network/storage IO. We should define 'searchable' vs 'raw' SLAs.
Maya (Product): proposal: searchable-evidence SLA = 24h for 13mo tier; raw-export SLA = 72h for <=100GB, 7d for >100GB. Add explicit expedited/dedicated option with higher cost. Thoughts? :thinking_face:
Priya (Legal): that split seems reasonable. Add carve-outs for legal holds and subpoenas. Also we need a manifest schema for chain-of-custody. Example: `{"export_id":"uuid","created_by":"redwood","hash":"sha256:...","kms_key_id":"arn:..."}`
Ravi (Eng-Infra): technical mitigation: we can implement a pre-provision KMS handshake for enterprise customers (pre-register key material, avoid on-demand escrow). That reduces handshake to ~<5m but requires infra changes and a secure onboarding flow.
Tom (Sales): customers will pay for faster raw exports. Recommend packaging expedited-export as an add-on in contracts. Also clarify SLAs in the T&Cs.
Lena (Security): I'll scope the BYOK security gaps doc and list controls needed for pre-provision flow (attestation, rotation, audit logs).
Omar (SRE): action: I'll run export throughput benches (cold vs hot) and surface typical time/cost for 50/200/1000GB exports. ETA Wed.
Ravi (Eng-Infra): action: spike pre-provision KMS flow this sprint, deliver prototype + risk notes by Thu.
Priya (Legal): action: draft chain-of-custody manifest spec and legal carve-outs; share for review by Fri.
Maya (Product): I'll convert this to an epic with acceptance criteria: 1) retention tiers defined and documented; 2) searchable vs raw SLAs specified; 3) BYOK handshake mitigation (pre-provision) implemented for expedited customers; 4) chain-of-custody manifest JSON schema released + legal sign-off.
Tom (Sales): I'll prepare pricing language and sample contract paragraph for expedited export.
Maya (Product): thanks all — if no major objections I'll create GH epic and link tickets for the spikes. :+1:
Ravi (Eng-Infra): +1.
Lena (Security): +1, tagging security review required.
Omar (SRE): noted, will post bench numbers.
Priya (Legal): ack.
Tom (Sales): ack, will sync with Maya on contract wording.
